user.title: Govee Native — Android account
user.description: Provide the Govee Home email/password to use the private Android app API. Developer API key is optional for full capability controls. An email code may be required.

verify.title: Verify Govee Home account
verify.description: Enter the verification code Govee emailed to your account. Codes expire after roughly 15 minutes.

error.invalid_input: Enter email and password together, or provide a Developer API key
error.cannot_send_code: Could not send the Govee verification email

abort.already_configured: This Govee account is already configured

data.app_mqtt: Use private AWS IoT MQTT (Govee app account)
data.use_legacy_api_key: Use existing legacy Govee Developer API key for scenes and fallback (opt-in; may increase API traffic)
data.prefer_bluetooth: Prefer Bluetooth before LAN and cloud
data.configure_bluetooth: Set a Bluetooth address for a supported light
data.daily_request_budget: Developer API read budget per day (control keeps a reserve)

bluetooth.title: Bluetooth address
bluetooth.description: Select a supported light and enter its six-byte Bluetooth MAC address from Govee device information or Home Assistant Bluetooth discovery.

segments.title: Segment controls
segments.description: Choose devices and how their segment lights appear. Colours are remembered across restarts. Brightness is offered only when independently supported.

error.invalid_bluetooth_address: Select a supported light and enter its six-byte Bluetooth MAC address.
error.invalid_segment_selection: Select discovered devices and a segment display mode.

abort.no_bluetooth_devices: No supported H6199 or H1270 light was discovered.
abort.no_segment_devices: No devices advertise addressable RGBIC segments.
